name: JINENDRA ELECTRICAL HARDWARE AND PAINTS
description:
Jinendra Electrical Hardware & Paints is a trusted hardware store located in Andheri East, Mumbai. We supply a wide range of electrical, plumbing, and hardware materials for homes, contractors, and construction projects. We are an authorized dealer of Asian Paints and offer quality products at competitive prices.

Our products include PVC pipes and fittings, electrical switches and sockets, LED bulbs, plumbing fittings, screws, tapes, tools, and complete paint solutions. We provide reliable service for homeowners, plumbers, electricians, painters, and contractors.

Visit us for genuine products, quick service, and all your hardware and paint needs in one place.
